caption: The drawing features a simple line illustration of a rectangular, slightly flared vessel or plaque, depicted in black ink on a cream-colored or off-white background. The object has a flat top, straight sides that gently curve outward, and a base consisting of two horizontal lines above a slightly thicker, rectangular platform. Centered within the outlined shape, there is a handwritten inscription in cursive script that reads: "A Gift To the Church of Northford by Josiah Rogers their first Deacon." To the left of the vessel, there is a small circular symbol with two horizontal lines. In the lower right corner of the image, "Lawrence Flynt" is written in stylized cursive, serving as a signature. The composition is minimal, with the primary focus on the centrally placed vessel and inscription, and the surrounding space left blank.
title: Silver Beaker
